query: A national data governance framework will define decision rights, standards and accountability.
Data owners and stewards will be appointed in each ministry under a government data council.
A data catalogue, business glossary and quality rules will be implemented.
Authoritative registries will provide governed master data for persons and businesses.
Retention schedules, ethical-use reviews and compliance monitoring will govern the data lifecycle.
The project will establish policies, roles and standards that make institutions accountable for how data is managed.
